function: Selects the semi-synchronized path set, i.e., which UAV multipaths each AP serves with analog beams and delays, by GCN maximal-clique detection for asynchronous cooperative beamforming (pp. 3, 10).
system: Wideband mmWave cell-free massive MIMO downlink: 18 APs, 128-antenna ULA, 10 RF chains, analog delay modules; 20-40 single-antenna UAVs; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 11).
method: Geometric scattering GCN from [41] (linear input layer, 3 SCTConv layers, two linear layers), unsupervised training with the label-free clique loss (36) for 200 epochs (pp. 10-11).
data_channel: Simulated Saleh-Valenzuela mmWave multipath channel (3 paths, LoS and NLoS, propagation delays) over a 1 km x 1 km area; GCN training data not described (pp. 3, 11).
test_conditions: Training conditions not described beyond hyperparameters; tests with 20, 30, and 40 UAVs and 32 to 256 antennas, without saying whether the GCN is retrained (pp. 11-13).
baselines: Non-learned only: uniform-power BDAT, the hybrid delay hybrid beamforming architecture of Fig. 5, and the Bron-Kerbosch maximal clique list; no learned baseline (pp. 11-13).
metrics: Per-UE spectral efficiency CDF, energy efficiency and transmit power CDFs, and CDF of the selected clique index ratio against the Bron-Kerbosch list (pp. 11-13).
complexity: AP side O(K^2 N); GCN O(K^2 P^2); Algorithm 2 O(K^2 P^2); centralized power optimization O(-log(eps) L^3 K^3); fronthaul overhead L N_D^2 + L N_D + K (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 3: "Salen-Valenzula is adopted in this paper". Custom Saleh-Valenzuela simulator; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured channel is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "The training hyperparameters are as follows: 0.002 for learning rate, 0.09 for penalty coefficient and 0.5 for dropout in the SCTConv layers and 200 for training epochs." Missing: the training data and any test in conditions not used for training; the results for 20, 30, and 40 UAVs (pp. 11-13) do not say the GCN was trained on another setting.
q3_support: p. 13: "the total maximal clique list obtained by Bron-Kerbosch algorithm"; p. 12: "overwhelms the one simply combining BDAT and the time delay network for beam split". Only non-learned comparisons; no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 11: "The complexity in APs can be expressed as O(K^2 N)" and "The complexity of GCN, permutation and the second block of nested loops are O(K^2P^2), O(KP log KP) and O(κN_D KP)".
q5_support: p. 3: "Salen-Valenzula is adopted in this paper" (simulated channel, no public dataset). No code or data link appears; p. 11 only points to another paper for the GCN: "The detailed design especially the implementation of SCTConv can be found in [41]".
notes: Included: the GCN has trained parameters (p. 10: "Θ in (35) is the learnable parameter set in GCN") and selects the SSP-Set, i.e., the serving indicators of the precoding problem (11) (p. 4: "an indicator implying whether l-th AP serves k-th UE in p-th path"; p. 5). Beams (array responses), delays, and powers are closed-form or bisection (Algorithm 1, p. 10). The paper calls the SSP-Set an "association strategy" (p. 3), but it chooses which paths get analog beams so as to avoid ICI and ISI, so I read it as beam selection (area 3), not above_phy. Area 3 rather than 6: the UAVs are UEs of a terrestrial cell-free network (p. 3: "UAVs in our system are UES instead of base stations or relays"), and the paper sets LEO and HAPS aside (pp. 1-2); reviewer may confirm whether ground-to-UAV links count as aerial links of area 6. Carrier frequency and bandwidth are not stated (Table I, p. 11, gives only mmWave and a 2.34 us CP). The GCN itself is evaluated only by the clique index ratio against Bron-Kerbosch (Fig. 16, p. 13), not by spectral efficiency.
